ثَمِرٌ (tropical:) Wealth blessed with increase: (A, TA:) or much, or abundant, wealth; as also ↓ مَثْمُورٌ . (K.) ―
-b2- أَرْضٌ ثَمِرَةٌ: see ثَمْرَآءُ. ―
-b3- مَا نَفْسِى لَكَ بِثَمِرَةٍ (tropical:) My mind has no sweetness for thee: (K, TA:) but accord. to Z, in the A, art. تمر, the last word in this phrase is with ت, and so it is written in the K in that art., and explained as meaning طَيِّبَةٌ [or agreeably affected]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
